Asset type: unit-raider-greatsword, one production battle sprite for an original dark-fantasy mercenary game, sprite-based 2.5D; final 512x512 square.
Input images: Image 1 unit-merc-sword.png and Image 2 unit-raider-axe.png are approved STYLE and SCALE references only. Create a new character, not a copy. Match their broad-brush black ink contours, coarse purposeful hatching, chunky dark shadow masses and muted earthy brown/taupe/grey wash, with the same anatomical proportions and readable game-scale detail. No glossy 3D, no smooth digital painting.
Subject: a big broad-shouldered river raider in a battered scrap-mail shirt over coarse plain cloth, worn belt, ragged trousers and wrapped boots. Rough weather-beaten face. Holds ONE rusty practical two-handed sword with both hands, blade reaching diagonally toward the LEFT, its full length visible. Head, gaze and torso face LEFT. The mail is irregular repaired iron links, not plate armor; sword is usable and proportionate, not an oversized fantasy slab. No axe, shield or other weapon.
Composition: exactly one complete full-body figure, grounded heavy ready stance. Fixed three-quarter top-down battle camera about 50 degrees downward, visible top surfaces, never eye-level, never flat side elevation. Figure slightly broader than the axe raider, at the same human scale; silhouette reaches approximately y=25 to y=485 on the final 512 canvas. Feet near bottom centre, ground anchor about x=256 y=480. Entire head, sword tip and boots inside canvas with clear padding. No crop, scenery, platform, base or drawn hex.
Background: perfectly flat uniform solid #00ff00 chroma-key green for local alpha removal. No green anywhere in the subject. Background has no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane or lighting variation. Opaque subject with crisp ink edges; no stray ink specks outside silhouette, no cast or contact shadow.
Constraints: original designs only; do not imitate any existing game, franchise character or artist. No text, logos, watermark, border, UI or extra characters. Deliver ONE separate square image, not a sheet or collage.
